validation_notes.expected_source: All expected content below is transcribed from the four preserved visual review samples above, never from the database under test.
validation_notes.source_binding: validate() automatically adds expected.source_sha256 from each independent case's reference_sample_id. The reference sample hash is authoritative over any per-case hash override; it must match the same returned row as the content, location and quality assertions, including visual locator branches. A wrong, missing or null returned hash fails. No reference hash or content expectation is rewritten.
validation_notes.legacy_76_cases: Preserve the pilot validation set unchanged as functional smoke, not an independent content quality gold set.
validation_notes.table_coordinates: String row/column keys require exact, unique labels in a structured matrix; integer coordinates are zero-based. Flattened numbers are not cells.
validation_notes.table_fallback: A visual_required table can pass location and restriction checks only. It must not be counted as independently validated table content.
validation_notes.table_quality_contract: standards_query.get_table returns both table_quality_status and quality_status as visual_required for the visual locator branch; this does not establish verified cells or allow final design advice.

report_fields.independent_quality_gold: Provenance only: true means every case qualifies as an independently sourced reference case. It may remain true even when all cases fail; it is not a pass result, corpus quality approval, or engineering approval.
report_fields.passed_count: Number of cases whose assertions passed, including restricted visual locator cases. This count alone does not mean all content was independently validated.
report_fields.independent_content_passed_count: Number of independently sourced cases whose content assertions and all other required assertions passed. Visual locator-only passes are excluded.
report_fields.independent_content_validation_passed: Pass result: true only when every case in the independent set passes content validation. Missing printed pages, unresolved review status, wrong units, and visual locator-only results must not be interpreted as content passes.
report_fields.visual_locator_only_passed_count: Number of cases that passed visual location and restriction checks without validating table cells. These remain excluded from independent_content_passed_count.

validation_notes.adjacent_body_source: The additional excluded body fragments were visually rechecked on GB 50223-2008 physical page 7 and GB 50367-2013 physical page 22, including cases where OCR loses the adjacent clause number.
validation_notes.continuation_scope: For 3.1.7 only physical page 22 was reviewed; no unreviewed end page or continuation text is asserted.
